meta.name: microservices-patterns
meta.description: Design microservices architectures with service boundaries, event-driven communication, and resilience patterns. Use when building distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices.

copy.tagline: 设计微服务架构与交互模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正需要设计微服务架构或拆分已有系统。
copy.tagline_en: Design microservices with patterns for boundaries, events, resilience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing microservices or breaking up a monolith.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你设计微服务架构:划分服务边界与契约、选服务间通信方式(同步 REST/gRPC 或事件驱动)、处理分布式数据与容错(如熔断、重试、舱壁)。
howto.when: 当你要构建分布式系统、拆分单体应用或落地微服务时触发,也用于设计服务边界、服务间通信等场景。

say.text: 帮我把这个单体应用拆成几个微服务,划分服务边界
say.note: 会给出拆分策略与服务清单

say.text: 订单和支付服务之间,该用同步调用还是事件驱动?
say.note: 会对比通信模式并给出取舍

say.text: 帮我给这些服务加上熔断和重试的容错方案
say.note: 会输出对应的韧性模式写法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude designs microservice architectures: service boundaries and contracts, inter-service communication (sync REST/gRPC or event-driven), and distributed data plus resilience patterns like circuit breaker, retry and bulkhead.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices; also covers designing service boundaries and inter-service communication.

say_en.text: Split this monolith into microservices and define the service boundaries.
say_en.note: Returns a decomposition strategy and service list.

say_en.text: Should order and payment talk via sync calls or events?
Add circuit breaker and retry resilience to these services.
say_en.note: Outputs the matching resilience pattern code.
